title: Christmas Markets Near Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Potsdam is the easy one:** four Christmas markets under an hour away on your Berlin ABC ticket, led by the **Weihnachtszauber on Brandenburger Strasse, 23 November to 27 December**.

**Leipzig beats Dresden on a single free day:** about **1 hour 15 minutes** by direct ICE, a market across the whole old town from **24 November to 23 December**, open until 22:00 on Fridays and Saturdays.
**Dresden's Striezelmarkt runs 25 November to 24 December**, two hours away. On Saturday 5 December the **last direct train back leaves at 20:53**.

**Four markets open only on weekends:** Babelsberg's Bohemian market, the Spreewaldweihnacht in Lübbenau, Quedlinburg's Advent in the Courtyards and Potsdam's Sinterklaas. **28-29 November and 5-6 December** are the days when nearly all of them are open.
**Book the Spreewald punt now:** the boat and the Lehde museum need a timed ticket, and unsold places come back on **1 November**.
**My move:** on a normal Saturday take the 10:00 ICE to Leipzig; on the first two Advent weekends go for Quedlinburg or the Spreewald.
